description: Pause up to 100 tracked queries: their checks stop until resume_tracked_queries restarts them, so they spend no budget meanwhile; use get_usage to see the effect. Checks skipped while paused are never made up later, and pausing also cancels a check still in progress. Each one that cannot be paused is reported in "failed". Safe to retry.
name: pause_tracked_queries
title: Pause tracked queries
